method: HomeCheck localization, semantic-entity and interacting-rule-family repair, repository evidence, and verification-guided iteration

candidate_session.target_unit: semantic code entity plus all interacting rule-family findings
candidate_session.coverage: every frozen alert location in every affected file
candidate_session.blocked_policy: ordinary blocked entries never satisfy coverage; risk increases required evidence rather than removing a target
candidate_session.external_constraint_policy: unresolved_external is reportable but is not completed or counted as repaired
candidate_session.source_guard: reject deleted source files, large deletions, and removed declarations
candidate_session.source_preservation: retain every pre-existing struct, class, component, function, method, build method, exported symbol, and public API; never replace a component by deleting its original declaration
candidate_session.agent_controller_boundary: when HAPREPAIR_AGENT_MODE=1, the agent edits source/configuration and the completion report only; all session mutations and HomeCheck scans remain evaluator-only
candidate_session.public_api_guard: compare package-entrypoint exported API fingerprints with the initial project
candidate_session.semantic_guard: reject new indexOf workarounds, unproven @Reusable additions, and unproven state-decorator changes
candidate_session.namespace_export_guard: reject removal or redirection of baseline export-star-as namespace barrels
candidate_session.toolchain_boundary: never edit project-local hvigor wrappers, evaluator caches, SDK files, or environment files to bypass infrastructure failures
candidate_session.resource_schema_safety: dark-mode resources must be non-empty and schema-valid, with base/dark key correspondence
candidate_session.import_graph_safety: no-cycle repairs require a complete edge classification, behavior-preserving graph transformation, and unchanged package-entry API; export/import rule exchanges are incomplete
candidate_session.build_test_order: configured build, configured tests, then HomeCheck validation
candidate_session.arkts_warning_policy: inject Hvigor ignoreWarning by default; strict mode is opt-in
candidate_session.failed_build_or_test: retain and repair the candidate in place without consuming a HomeCheck validation scan
candidate_session.sibling_exchange_policy: a same-file related-family alert exchange cannot promote best-valid
candidate_session.finalization: restore best-valid when necessary before the evaluator-only final scan

semantic_specs.coverage: 63 frozen-corpus rules plus eight observed rules absent from the corpus
semantic_specs.planning: exact rule-to-family routing plus same-file five-line interaction candidates

repair_examples.purpose: provenance and optional pattern evidence only; examples are never patch templates

round_policy.coverage: repair every current alert location before validation
round_policy.context: coding-agent-native repository search without a fixed line window
round_policy.transformation: one joint behavior-preserving change per semantic entity and interacting rule family
round_policy.feedback: residual and introduced HomeCheck findings from the preceding validation scan
round_policy.failed_candidate: repair in place; never perform project-level or whole-round rollback

claim_boundary: HomeCheck alert elimination is not semantic correctness; real-project claims apply only to detected alerts; security evidence is limited to observed rules
